title: ParadokS
wikitext:
Legendary Danish player famous for his aggressive gameplay on [[DM6]] when dueling, as well as elaborate tactics and all-round skills in [[teamplay]]. Founded [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Slackers]] in [[2001]] together with [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Goljat]] and has been active in a lot of Quakeworld related projects such [[Duelmania]], [[QuakeWorld.nu]] and live commentary of official matches.
